notes.content:
* Added Czech localization (thanks to siSINka)
* Fixed a bug that caused the BGM to stop playing in rare cases
Added Japanese localization (thanks to Hiroshi Ashida)

Moved letter closer to the camera when inspecting to improve readability
 Can now also rotate objects with left analog stick when inspecting
 Default look sensibility for controllers increased
 Increased size of crosshair
 Now drops inspected objects when pausing

Adds the possibility to reset the cube in level 20
 A happy tune is now playing when solving the sakura machine in level 22

23.5.855103755: Memorize Machine

The state of the machine can now also be memorized like solution panels and other elements.
This does not apply to the very first machine of the game to not overwhelm players.

[previewyoutube=eBDQ3tpPPVc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Added level numbers to level selection screen
 (Level 17) Platform progress indicators now actually indicate the platform progress
